# SimpleAI Translator v1.0.0

This release refocuses SimpleAI Translator on translation, language detection, translation history, and text-to-speech.

## BREAKING

-   OCR, screenshot translation, writing assistant, vocabulary book, custom Action management, promotion banners, and the old polishing, summarize, analyze, explain-code, and big-bang modes were removed.
-   Vendor-specific provider settings were replaced by protocol-based LLM Providers: `openai-chat`, `openai-responses`, and `anthropic`.
-   Built-in vendor adapters and templates for Azure, Gemini, MiniMax, DeepSeek, Moonshot, ChatGLM, Cohere, Groq, Cerebras, Kimi, Ollama, ChatGPT Web, and related legacy providers were removed.
-   Old provider settings are not migrated. Existing `apiKeys`, `apiURL`, `provider`, `azure*`, and other legacy fields are ignored and removed on the next settings write.
-   Old history, vocabulary, and Action data are not migrated.
-   Browser extension custom endpoints now require optional host permission approval at runtime.
-   The desktop Bundle ID changed to `io.zeroclover.app.simpleai-translator`; the app starts with a fresh data directory.
-   Global shortcuts, automatic translation, selection-triggered floating icons, sponsor prompts, and telemetry were removed.

## Added

-   Multi-provider configuration for OpenAI Chat Completions compatible APIs, OpenAI Responses compatible APIs, and Anthropic Messages compatible APIs.
-   Dynamic model refresh and filtering for translation models.
-   OpenAI-compatible TTS through `/audio/speech`, reusing an existing OpenAI-compatible Provider.
-   TTS model filtering for `tts-1`, `tts-1-hd`, `gpt-4o-mini-tts`, and matching dated snapshots.

## Rollback

The previous source tree is available at:

https://github.com/nextai-translator/nextai-translator/tree/v-pre-slim

## Manual Release Checklist

-   Start the desktop app and leave it idle for 60 seconds. On macOS, verify with `nettop` or an equivalent packet monitor that there are no outbound connections to `sentry.io`, `google-analytics.com`, `googletagmanager.com`, `aptabase.com`, or `aptabase.io`.
